description: Compute the monthly average order value (AOV) and average items per order by sales channel for paid orders (status = 'paid'). AOV = SUM(total_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT order_id). Average items per order = SUM(quantity) / COUNT(DISTINCT order_id). Zero-value orders (total_amount = 0, e.g. fully discounted) are included in the denominator. Output columns: month (DATE), channel (STRING), order_count (INT64), aov (FLOAT64, rounded to 2 decimals), avg_items_per_order (FLOAT64, rounded to 2 decimals).

order_id.description: Foreign key to orders; one order has one or more items

quantity.description: Units of this SKU in the order

edge_cases: Order with multiple item rows must contribute total_amount only once
Zero-value orders count toward order_count and lower the AOV
Orders with no rows in order_items should still count toward AOV with 0 items
common_failure_modes: FM1: Joining orders to order_items before summing total_amount multiplies the order total by the number of item rows
FM3: Using AVG(total_amount) after the join averages over item rows instead of orders
